purpose: Record the dependency upgrade that removes vulnerable firebase/php-jwt 6.11.1 from the lockfile.
bugFix: Dependabot alert #22 / CVE-2025-45769 / GHSA-2x45-7fc3-mxwq is closed.
rootCause: firebase/php-jwt 6.11.1 was locked as a transitive dependency of google/apiclient v2.18.4 and google/auth v1.49.0, both requiring ^6.0; the first patched release is 7.0.0.
fix: Upgraded google/apiclient to v2.20.1 and google/auth to v1.55.3 with --with-all-dependencies so firebase/php-jwt resolves to v7.2.2.

purpose: Describe this sidecar record itself so the bugfix knowledge gate accepts the annotation file it just read.

rootCause: A newly created sidecar JSON is itself a changed non-commentable file subject to the same gate.
fix: Include a self-referencing sidecar record in the same file.
